description_en: Queries the details and extended information of a server asset by UUID
description_zh: 根据UUID查询服务器资产详情和扩展信息
name: GetAssetDetailByUuid

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request. You do not need to specify this parameter. The system automatically obtains this value
parameters.help_zh: 请求源IP。无需填写，系统自动获取
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The UUID of the asset that you want to query.
Call the [DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的资产的UUID。
调用[DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~)接口获取该参数
parameters.name: uuid

parameters.help_en:
The language type for the request and response messages. Default value: zh. Valid values:
zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型。默认为zh。取值：
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang
